note: SELF-HOSTING BLOCKER register: D12 B-01..B-20 re-classified against D23-D26 evidence (closed rows kept) plus the language and law-engine blockers D27 found.  class: unimplemented | architectural | architectural-limit (a fact the design absorbs) | design | test-gap | environmental | owner-decision | closed.  A GAP/ERR/UNK row is either in the implementation sequence or an explicit environmental / owner / limit boundary.

rows.blocker: no Factory WebApp: no UI, no generation, no browser state model
rows.required_semantic_behaviour: an installed generation runs the delta pipeline as deterministic state transitions over local objects
rows.browser_native_mechanism: generation = objects (JS, wasm law engine, wasm kernel, data) named by a manifest, booted confined by the seed, fed by the broker
rows.test: [GAP] FC-3 generation boot + one delta routed entirely inside the browser

rows.blocker: every canonical/workpiece state operation is a git subprocess
rows.required_semantic_behaviour: content-addressed objects, tree identity, overlay workpieces, CAS refs with git-identical ids
rows.browser_native_mechanism: WebCrypto SHA-1 + CompressionStream loose objects in OPFS; IDB refs with CAS; overlay records
rows.test: [GAP] FC-2 equality with git on the repository's own tree (ids RUN: P09)

rows.blocker: station commands are OS programs (152/152 of D0-D11; every later fixture likewise): none executable by a browser
rows.required_semantic_behaviour: bounded capability invocation with receipts naming capability, adapter and environment identity
rows.browser_native_mechanism: operation classes + adapters (Linux for the RUST_BUILD epoch and receipt parity; browser for everything the installed Factory runs itself)
rows.test: [GAP] FC-4 receipt parity on both adapters
rows.note: ERR for portability; D12 section 5 proves the operation-class abstraction is necessary, not elegant

rows.blocker: RUST_BUILD exists only on a host: compiled objects (kernel, templates, the future law engine) need rustc + LLVM + rust-src + cargo -Z build-std=core
rows.required_semantic_behaviour: compile the first-party Rust source (12 no_std crates + wasm-abi + the law engine) to wasm64 inside the browser, with an identity checkable against a host build
rows.browser_native_mechanism: candidates B1 hosted toolchain, B2 FactTest-native, B3 import-only (L3-A), B4 first-party subset compiler, B5 hosted rustc + cranelift (tests/closure/registers/rust-build.json)
rows.test: [UNK] FC-7 feasibility spike with measurable exit criteria after decision D-3
rows.note: the deepest boundary: acceptance steps 3-4 need it; every other step closes without it (B3)

rows.blocker: generated-object templates are compiled into the kernel (include_str!): a host/JS change needs a kernel rebuild
rows.required_semantic_behaviour: host/JS templates change without RUST_BUILD
rows.browser_native_mechanism: templates as recipe data submitted through the ABI (a new operation = ABI version 2); the kernel binds them by identity into strategy data
rows.test: [GAP] FC-6: a template change swaps a generation with the kernel identity unchanged

rows.blocker: wasm ABI transport incomplete (six exports missing in D12)
rows.required_semantic_behaviour: BUILD + OBSERVE in the browser byte-identical to the native driver
rows.browser_native_mechanism: compiler/wasm-abi (21 exports = the whole kernel API)
rows.note: closed by D23; kept so the register stays complete

rows.blocker: BUILD reports OK with no contract registry and no plan
rows.required_semantic_behaviour: BUILD without a registry reports NO_PLAN, or the current OK is confirmed as intended
rows.browser_native_mechanism: kernel semantics (a compiler change under the evolution contract if decided)

rows.blocker: a service worker cannot replace itself offline; a broken seed blocks its scope with no offline recovery
rows.required_semantic_behaviour: the seed is total, minimal, qualified before installation, and recovery never depends on generation code
rows.browser_native_mechanism: seed = sw.js (router, pointer boot, hash-checked serving, broker, recovery view); replacement is an origin event
rows.note: a limit the design absorbs, not a gap to close

rows.blocker: same-origin code reaches every storage of the origin
rows.required_semantic_behaviour: generation code never runs same-origin; storage only through the broker
rows.browser_native_mechanism: opaque sandboxed frame + postMessage broker
rows.test: FC-1 confinement probe on the real seed

rows.blocker: opaque frames have no active service worker: a URL-loaded confined frame fails offline
rows.required_semantic_behaviour: the generation bootstrap is inline (srcdoc) and its code arrives by postMessage
rows.browser_native_mechanism: inline bootstrap + broker-sent blobs

rows.blocker: storage is best-effort; persist() false in the headless shell; installed-Factory durability never observed
rows.required_semantic_behaviour: the installed Factory's objects and pointers survive storage pressure
rows.browser_native_mechanism: navigator.storage.persist() granted to an installed site in full Chrome; export/import of objects as the fallback
rows.test: [UNK] needs an installed full Chrome (not available in this environment)

rows.blocker: toolchain unpinned; compiled identity drifts
rows.required_semantic_behaviour: a compiled object has one expected identity per source tree
rows.browser_native_mechanism: proof sets pin (D13) + kernel exec identity pinned from the committed source (D24)

rows.blocker: verifier provenance: the judge's binary sha256 is recorded (format 2) but not its source commit
rows.required_semantic_behaviour: the generation manifest names the law-engine object that judged each receipt
rows.browser_native_mechanism: receipt names verifier object id + generation id

rows.blocker: workpiece cleanup / audit durability
rows.required_semantic_behaviour: proven-safe retirement
rows.browser_native_mechanism: factory workpiece audit/retire (D13)
rows.note: closed by D13 on the host; the browser equivalent is FC-2

rows.blocker: home origin undecided (githack and *.github.io are shared origins)
rows.required_semantic_behaviour: a dedicated HTTPS origin whose storage no other page shares
rows.browser_native_mechanism: dedicated host (recommended by P03 + P08)

rows.blocker: generated apps served on the Factory origin share its trust domain
rows.required_semantic_behaviour: FactTest.git != generated WebApp (the Factory invariant)
rows.browser_native_mechanism: separate origins per app, or explicit acceptance
rows.test: owner decision D-2; FC-8 probes the chosen answer

rows.blocker: packfile import/export and history walks are unimplemented
rows.required_semantic_behaviour: full history in the browser, or a recorded history horizon
rows.browser_native_mechanism: packfile parser (zlib + deltas) or import of the current tree with a horizon record
rows.test: [GAP] FC-2 (loose objects), FC-8 (packfiles); owner decision D-9

rows.blocker: GitHub smart-HTTP is not CORS-readable; credentials must stay outside generations
rows.required_semantic_behaviour: optional remote replication with credentials held by the broker
rows.browser_native_mechanism: GitHub REST (CORS-open) behind the broker; smart-HTTP only through a proxy (which joins the TCB)

rows.blocker: public HTTPS execution never observed from this environment
rows.required_semantic_behaviour: a generated bundle and later the Factory run on a public secure-context origin
rows.browser_native_mechanism: tests/physical/PUBLIC-HTTPS-PROBE.md (deployable probe)

rows.blocker: browser update behaviour of seed and generations
rows.required_semantic_behaviour: a browser version change re-runs admission and qualification; a seed incompatibility is a P14-class failure
rows.browser_native_mechanism: STALE_IF browser.version on every generation claim; qualification probes re-run

rows.blocker: the language version is not identified in source; before D27 the grammar text declared no version
rows.required_semantic_behaviour: a source unit names the language version it is written in; the grammar and the compiler agree on the current version
rows.browser_native_mechanism: D27: LANGUAGE VERSION 1 bound by annotation + derived manifest check; a version island is a LANGUAGE 2 candidate

rows.blocker: observed ASCII is indistinguishable from authored source: ANALYZE accepts it
rows.required_semantic_behaviour: evidence never silently becomes source
rows.browser_native_mechanism: a source-role statement or an evidence dialect that is not a source unit (LANGUAGE 2); until then Factory law (L-EV-5)

rows.blocker: the running kernel cannot be asked for its vocabulary or the legal forms at a position
rows.required_semantic_behaviour: a local model discovers the vocabulary from the compiler it talks to
rows.browser_native_mechanism: QUERY_LANGUAGE_MANIFEST ABI operation (ABI 2) returning the manifest bytes; diagnostics with an expected-forms parameter

rows.blocker: the presentation-equivalence property (L30) is witnessed by fixed transforms only
rows.required_semantic_behaviour: for every presentation-preserving T: Semantic(Parse(S)) == Semantic(Parse(T(S)))
rows.browser_native_mechanism: a generator over the corpus (frames, whitespace, relocation, prose, order)

rows.blocker: the Factory law engine is a std crate (process, fs, git): not browser-executable as written
rows.required_semantic_behaviour: the law (delta check, authority, verify, integrate, reinspect) as deterministic functions over objects
rows.browser_native_mechanism: a no_std law crate compiled to wasm with a host membrane (the same architecture as the compiler kernel)
rows.test: [GAP] FC-3 verdict parity with the host judge on f00-f28

rows.blocker: no station had authority over the language-law documents (census at the D27 base: five documents, zero stations)
rows.required_semantic_behaviour: language law changes only through a station bound to the compiler that implements the language
rows.browser_native_mechanism: S-LANGUAGE-LAW (registered by D27: insertion-only, version bound, version-change mode coupled to S-RUST and the evolution qualification)
rows.test: station authority census before/after; f02 (authority expansion refused) on the host

rows.blocker: kernel capacity: 8 source units, 64 KiB, 512 islands, 256 objects/relations per workspace; no composition across workspaces
rows.required_semantic_behaviour: a system the size of the Factory is described conversationally through subsystems compiled separately and imported by their public contracts
rows.browser_native_mechanism: separate compilation by public contract (KERNEL 2); the limits are compiler constants

rows.blocker: no independent qualification runner for a candidate generation / compiler N+1 (D12 Q1-Q7)
rows.required_semantic_behaviour: N qualifies N+1: manifest completeness, source provenance, compiled-object receipts, law self-tests, specimens re-verified by N, re-qualification set from the graph, non-mutation
rows.browser_native_mechanism: qualification runner in generation N feeding the confined candidate (corpus oracle, specimens, BundleVerifier of N, witness scenarios)

rows.blocker: no seed, broker, generation manifest or pointer schema exists
rows.required_semantic_behaviour: boot, promote on startup_ok, rollback on failure, recovery view, offline throughout
rows.browser_native_mechanism: tests/closure/registers/seed.json (the minimal trusted seed)

rows.blocker: the generated runtime does not verify its own files at load (I-33)
rows.required_semantic_behaviour: tamper detection external, against bundle.json
rows.browser_native_mechanism: in the installed Factory the SEED hash-checks every object it serves (seed rule 2), so generation integrity does not depend on this owner decision
